producer_report.summary: A request's rung now comes from what it serves in BRIEF.md and its addenda. `infer_rung` matches the request text and reading summary against BRIEF.md section headings and addendum text, which `Lookup` supplies as `brief` topics, so `plan_entry` does no I/O. A request that serves a brief section ranks at BriefRequirements, above Implementation. Words like "fix" or "bug" alone no longer give a rung. A request with no brief match falls back to Implementation only when it touches a path or the reading chose `change`; otherwise it has no rung. The two tests the send-back flagged are in reading.rs. I did not change the code in this pass. I re-ran the tests, and the full `cargo test --locked` passes. The fmt and clippy checks were not re-run in this pass.

checks_run.note: Run as `cargo test --locked -q`; all suites ok, 0 failed.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs plans a request about CI routing or parallel jobs against the real 2026-10-16 speed addendum text and asserts its rung is above Implementation. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test `a_request_serving_the_speed_addendum_ranks_above_implementation` reads the real BRIEF.md with include_str!. It asserts the 2026-10-16 speed addendum heading and its 'intelligent routing' text are present. It then asserts that 'Move compute to CI with intelligent routing of jobs' and 'Run parallel jobs for initiatives' each get Some(BriefRequirements), which is below Some(Implementation) in the ladder's derived order, so higher. `cargo test --locked -p athena-core` passed: 216 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test builds a plan from an old plain implementation request (a typo fix) and a newer speed-addendum request, and asserts the speed request is ordered first. Run `cargo test -p athena-core plan`.
criteria_check.evidence: The test `a_plan_orders_a_speed_request_before_an_older_typo_fix` builds a typo-fix entry (rung Implementation) listed first and a speed entry second, then runs Plan::build. It asserts plan.order == ["new", "old"]. The test name contains 'plan', so `cargo test -p athena-core plan` selects it. It passed in the `cargo test --locked -p athena-core` run.

criteria_check.criterion: A request that matches no brief section and has only an IMPLEMENTATION_WORDS word, such as 'fix a bug', no longer gets a rung from the word alone. A test asserts this, and the existing test `a_rung_is_inferred_from_evidence_or_flagged_never_defaulted_to_implementation` is updated to match.
criteria_check.evidence: `a_word_like_fix_or_bug_alone_is_no_rung` asserts that 'fix a bug', 'fix the typo in the intro' and 'update the docs and tests' each get None. The existing test `a_rung_is_inferred_from_evidence_or_flagged_never_defaulted_to_implementation` is still present and passes.

criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test --locked -q` showed every suite ok with 0 failed. I did not re-run clippy in this pass.
